title: Clean Active Window Mark
description: Active window mark should be the same fine line as inactive chrome (1px border-element weight) but with primary (active-base) color instead of a thick ring-2 inset.
summary: Multi-tab active chrome uses a stack-level CSS grid: tab bar subgrid places inactive tabs, active tab, gap, and controls in separate columns; stack body spans activeCol through controlsCol so border-active-base left edge aligns with the active tab and continues down (-mt-px) without breaking under sibling tabs.
